_meta.description: Log of every material disagreement between LLMs discovered during development. Each entry records what the two models said, which was correct (or if neither was), what action was taken, and whether the prompt was updated as a result.

statuses.resolved_prompt_fix: Disagreement was caused by ambiguous prompt; prompt updated to prevent recurrence
statuses.resolved_tolerance_fix: Disagreement was a false positive; tolerance rules updated
statuses.resolved_model_error: One model was clearly wrong; no prompt fix possible (model limitation)

entries.manual_verification: Syndicate 1183 reports both a regulatory segmental analysis (statutory classes) and a divisional summary (Marine, Property, Political Lines, Specialty, Treaty). The regulatory 'Marine' line (70.3) covers direct business only. The divisional 'Marine' total (302.9) aggregates direct + reinsurance, matching the true LOB exposure. Both GPT and Claude incorrectly read only the direct component from the regulatory table. Gemini correctly used the divisional total. Divisional totals sum to gross_premiums_written (1018.8).
entries.action: Added prompt instruction to prefer divisional totals over regulatory sub-categories when both are present

entries.manual_verification: Same root cause as DEV-010. GPT reported 6.9% (Marine direct-only as fraction of total), Gemini reported 29.73% (Marine divisional total as fraction of total). Gemini's percentage is consistent with 302.9 / 1018.8 = 29.73%.
entries.action: Covered by same prompt fix as DEV-010 (v1.6)
